proof_scope: fault-injected deterministic step-boundary validation only; not live dream quality or human perception proof

claims.proves: corrupt step JSON is blocked before execution with pydantic_errors[] and triage_errors[] carrying persona_dream_pydantic_step_gate_failed; valid schema envelope passes with no triage errors
claims.does_not_prove: full pipeline readiness, semantic dream quality, Chatterbox perceptual quality, or human-audible acceptance

capability_claims.description: Every Persona Dream DAG step failure carries Pydantic error data plus triage-error {code,cause,next_command} classification and the immutable goal records the Brave Search -> Ask gpt/fable -> Ask WebGPT self-heal ladder instead of prose-only BLOCKED output.

cases.name: pydantic-step-gate-triages-corrupt-input
command: T=$(mktemp -d); echo '{"not_schema":1}' > "$T/input.json"; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/dag_step.py --node-id eval-gate --command noop --receipt "$T/receipt.json" --run-dir "$T" --consumes input.json --produces ''; ec=$?; cat "$T/receipt.json"; exit $((ec==1 ? 0 : 1))

cases.name: pydantic-step-gate-passes-valid-envelope
command: T=$(mktemp -d); echo '{"schema":"some.thing.v1"}' > "$T/input.json"; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/dag_step.py --node-id eval-gate2 --command help --receipt "$T/receipt.json" --run-dir "$T" --consumes input.json --produces '' >/dev/null; python3 -c "import json;r=json.load(open('$T/receipt.json'));print('status',r['status']);print('gate_errors',len(r['pydantic_errors']));print('triage_errors',len(r['triage_errors']))"

cases.name: triage-catalog-classifies-pydantic-step-error
command: ../../triage-error/run.sh classify --text "pydantic_gate_input missing at ['input.json','schema']: Field required" --layer persona-dream | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d['code'], d['ambiguous'], bool(d['next_command']))"

cases.name: goal-records-self-heal-ladder
command:
python3 - <<'PY2'
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('../GOAL.md').read_text()
required=['Executable step boundary and self-heal ladder','brave-search','gpt/fable','webgpt','Pipeline step failures are expected states','Pydantic error data first','triage-error code/cause/next']
missing=[x for x in required if x not in s]
print('missing', missing)
raise SystemExit(1 if missing else 0)
PY2
